summary: Iteration 3 backend testing complete. 25/25 new pytest cases pass (100%) and the full backend suite is now 81/81 (100%) with zero regressions across iteration 1 (27) + iteration 2 (29) + iteration 3 (25). Verified: GET /api/audit/log returns 401 without bearer, 403 for an inserted role='viewer' user, and 200 for admin with entries[] where every entry has audit_id/action/resource/created_at and no _id. RBAC on POST /api/hr/employees returns 403 for viewer and 200 for admin. GET /api/ai/ops-brief returns 401 without bearer; with bearer it returns {brief: str, metrics: {open_tickets, fleet_active, inventory_low_stock, alerts_unread, ...}, cached: bool}; the second call within an hour returns cached=True with identical brief text — the LLM-fallback path is exercised gracefully when the live LLM call fails (deterministic synthetic brief). Audit-trail persistence verified by directly querying db.audit_log after performing switch/create-ticket/create-sale/create-employee/view-audit-log — all required actions {switch, create, view} are recorded against the test user (note: 'login' is not generated when the session is seeded via Mongo fixture, but the /api/auth/session code path explicitly calls `audit(user, 'login', 'auth')` and is exercised by the existing iteration_1 auth coverage). Regression sweep of 14 GET endpoints + 3 spot-checks (inventory bogus barcode, payroll t4 404, root) all 200/expected, and a literal `"_id"` substring scan against every response body confirms no ObjectId leakage across the surface. Test viewer user and admin user are inserted via the existing mongo-fixture pattern from conftest.py and cleaned up on teardown.

minor.issue: `audit_log(...)` declares `request: Request = None` as a parameter — FastAPI accepts this but normally `Request` is injected via Depends-less type-hint without a default. Currently it does receive the Request properly when route is invoked, but documenting the implicit injection is worth a refactor for clarity.

`_OPS_BRIEF_CACHE` is an in-process dict — multi-worker / multi-replica deployments will not share cache state. For single-worker uvicorn this is fine but should move to Mongo (e.g. db.cache) before scaling out.

The audit `action='login'` only fires through the live Emergent OAuth flow; tests cannot exercise this without a real session_token. Coverage of the login audit branch is therefore indirect (code-review only).

action_items: Consider moving _OPS_BRIEF_CACHE to MongoDB (db.cache) for multi-worker correctness before enabling >1 uvicorn worker.
Optionally remove the `request: Request = None` default in audit_log() and rely on plain `request: Request` injection.
server.py is now ~1020 lines — strong candidate to split audit_log + ops_brief into a dedicated /app/backend/routers/admin.py module before iteration 4.
critical_code_review_comments: RBAC implementation in core/deps.py uses a clean rank-based hierarchy (admin>manager>operator>viewer) and `require_role` is a proper FastAPI Depends factory — correct pattern.
audit() helper swallows ALL exceptions silently (`except Exception: pass`) — by design 'best-effort' but consider at minimum logging.exception so missed audit writes are visible.

ops_brief LLM call uses `await chat.send_message(...)` and treats response as either str or having .content; the fallback branch returns a deterministic string so the endpoint shape is stable even with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY misconfigured.
audit_log endpoint exposes the active company's audit only (good multi-tenant isolation), capped at min(500, max(1, limit)) — sane bounds.
POST /api/auth/session correctly calls audit(user, 'login', 'auth', meta={'email': email}) before returning the token.
seed_data_creation: A second user with role='viewer' is inserted via a module-scoped `viewer_user` fixture (mirrors conftest.seeded_user pattern). The viewer's user + session are wiped on teardown. db.audit_log entries created during the run are left in place intentionally (audit is append-only); created tickets/sales/employees are deleted after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For iteration 4: continue using conftest.seeded_user (admin) + module-scoped viewer_user fixture pattern for RBAC. Cache state for /api/ai/ops-brief is process-local (_OPS_BRIEF_CACHE dict) — restart backend or call /api/companies/switch to a fresh company to reset cache. Full test inventory: test_aidou_backend.py (iter1, 27), test_new_modules.py (iter2, 29), test_iteration_3.py (iter3, 25) = 81 passing. JUnit XMLs in /app/test_reports/pytest/. Use BASE_URL from conftest (EXPO_BACKEND_URL).
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in iteration 3. All 5 review-request acceptance criteria validated by explicit assertions in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_3.py and the full prior suite re-runs green confirming the new RBAC + audit + ops-brief code did not regress any iteration 1/2 endpoint.
